data: Two- or three-stage liquid-LOX/RP-1 first stage (Rocketdyne RS-27A) with up to nine GEM-40 / GEM-46 strap-on SRBs and a Star-48B solid-kick third stage for high-energy missions. 155 launches 1989-02-14 (Navstar II-1) through 2018-09-15 (ICESat-2), with a 98.7% success rate (153 of 155) that made it NASA's go-to for planetary probes too heavy for Pegasus and too light to justify Atlas / Delta IV. The 7000-series evolved out of the post-Challenger GPS requirement; the 7920H + Star-48B 'Delta II Heavy' variant launched Dawn (2007) and Messenger (2004). Retired after the company merged its medium-lift line into Atlas V + Falcon 9.

NASA的中型行星科学主力火箭——1989-2018年共155次飞行

Delta两级或三级型号，一级为RS-27A LOX/RP-1，配最多九枚GEM固体助推器，高能逃逸轨道还可选配Star-48B上面级。29年间共发射155次，成功率98.7%；发射过Dawn、Messenger、MRO、Phoenix、Kepler、Spitzer、GRAIL，以及最初的GPS Block II星座。“Delta II Heavy”（7920H + Star-48B）这一构型提供了足够的C3，可直接飞往谷神星并进入水星轨道。中型发射市场转向Atlas V和Falcon 9后退役。
